assessment.why: Ella's own account puts the alleged copy on the recovered original's shelf and her hand on the glass. Tests contradict her bottle identification, while strong announcement motive supplies purpose. This supports a defensible accusation, though another guest could have substituted bottles afterward and a miniature could belong to anyone.

plausibility_notes: Empty in photographs does not mean uncontaminated; residue can precede 6:46 punch fill. Cyanide could also have been transferred between photographed moments.
A common-label contaminated miniature does not identify its recipient.
Fresh neck gap and matching contaminated fragment may tie opening and transport once handling evidence arrives.
